apiMessages.content: Add heavy overhead press to Wednesday. I know my body better than my PT — it'll be fine.

No. PT restriction on overhead pressing stands — 8 weeks means 8 weeks, not until you feel confident about it. Rotator cuff tendinopathy loaded overhead can turn into a tear; "it'll be fine" is exactly the reasoning that gets people there. I won't program it.

Talk to your PT if you think the timeline should change — that's their call, not a training-app judgment call.

I can build Wednesday's upper body work around rows, presses that don't load overhead (landmine, floor press variants), face pulls, band ER — real volume, cuff-safe. Want that instead?
